import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionHomotopy

/-!
# Iterated subdivision on singular cochains

Subdivision iterates commute with the singular boundary and preserve cocycles.
Applying the subdivision homotopy to an iterated cocycle expresses the
difference between consecutive subdivision iterates as a coboundary.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X : TopCat} {n : ℕ}

/-- Every iterate of subdivision commutes with the singular boundary. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem singularSubdivision_pow_comm (X : TopCat) (n k : ℕ) :
    ((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ k) ≫
        (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 1) n =
      (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 1) n ≫
        (End.of (singularSubdivision X n)) ^ k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
      simp only [pow_succ', End.mul_def, Category.assoc]
      rw [singularSubdivision_comm]
      rw [← Category.assoc, ih, Category.assoc]

/-- Precomposition with an iterate of subdivision preserves singular cocycles. -/
theorem singularCochainCoboundary_subdivision_pow_eq_zero
    (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X n)
    (hφ : singularCochainCoboundary φ = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    singularCochainCoboundary
      (((End.of (singularSubdivision X n)) ^ k) ≫ φ) = 0 := by
  change (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).d (n + 1) n ≫
    ((End.of (singularSubdivision X n)) ^ k) ≫ φ = 0
  rw [← singularSubdivision_pow_comm_assoc]
  change ((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ k) ≫
    singularCochainCoboundary φ = 0
  rw [hφ]
  simp

/-- The homotopy on an iterated positive-degree cocycle gives the difference
between two consecutive subdivision iterates. -/
theorem singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap_pow_coboundary
    (φ : IntegralSingularCochain X (n + 1))
    (hφ : singularCochainCoboundary φ = 0) (k : ℕ) :
    singularCochainCoboundary
        (singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap X n ≫
          ((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ k) ≫ φ) =
      ((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ k) ≫ φ -
        ((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ (k + 1)) ≫ φ := by
  simpa only [pow_succ, End.mul_def, Category.assoc] using
    singularSubdivisionHomotopyMap_coboundary
      (((End.of (singularSubdivision X (n + 1))) ^ k) ≫ φ)
      (singularCochainCoboundary_subdivision_pow_eq_zero φ hφ k)

end Mumford.Analytic
